I've worked through all 78 convention rules for this change. There are two low-severity findings, and neither blocks the merge.

**Scope:** `e51c1262f...HEAD` is one commit (`1c3cce426`) touching one file, `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SafeSelectorDropdown/components/MultiChainSafeItemRow.tsx` (+4/−6). It moves `StatusBadge` out from under the chain name so it sits at the right, next to the pending count and balance. I wrote the checklist to the scratchpad instead of `docs/engineering/`, so no repo files were touched. I didn't need to zoom into review learnings or GitHub history for any rule.

## Findings

**1. UX-01: the "Read-only" pill can wrap at its hyphen** (low)
`MultiChainSafeItemRow.tsx:25` and `MultiChainSafeItemRow.tsx:79`
- The pill used to sit alone in a column under the name. Now it shares a row with the chain name (which takes the leftover width and truncates), the "N pending" badge and the balance.
- The pending badge (line 81) and the balance (line 88) both have `whitespace-nowrap`. The Read-only `<span>` has neither `whitespace-nowrap` nor `shrink-0`.
- When the row runs out of room, the span can shrink to its narrowest width and break "Read-only" into "Read-" / "only". The `leading-none` style makes that look especially broken.
- This can happen in practice: `hasQueued` only requires the chain to be deployed and have queued transactions, so a read-only chain can show both pills.
- Fix: add `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap` to the span, matching the other trailing items. `NotActivatedBadge` already applies `shrink-0` itself.

**2. TEST-02 / AGENTS.md "every code change must include tests": the moved badge isn't covered** (low)
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SafeSelectorDropdown/components/__tests__/MultiChainSafeItemRow.test.tsx`
- No tests changed. The existing tests only check that the Inactive/Activating badge exists, and they would still pass if the badge went back under the name.
- The `isReadOnly` branch of `StatusBadge` (`MultiChainSafeItemRow.tsx:23-29`) has no test at all.
- `SafeSelectorDropdown.stories.tsx` has no story for an expanded multi-chain row with an undeployed or read-only chain. `MixedActivationStates` only has single-chain rows, so there's no Storybook view to check the new layout visually.
- Suggestion: add a Read-only test case, and optionally a story for a multi-chain Safe with a mix of undeployed and read-only chains.

## Rules that applied and passed
- **PROD-01** (visible behaviour change): the commit message explains the reason (the icon-only badge from #8013 looked orphaned). Carry that into the PR description, and add design sign-off if you have it.
- **CODE-02, UI-01, UI-02, CODE-04:** nothing new was added. The hardcoded `text-[11px]` on the pill was already there before this change.
- **FEAT-04:** no files under `components/ui/*` were edited.
- **UX-03:** no shell component was replaced.
- The inline comment at `MultiChainSafeItemRow.tsx:72`, which says the badge is right-aligned, now matches what the code does.

The other 65 rules (auth, RTK, data, chain, transactions, mobile, CI, security, docs and similar) don't touch this change.
